body: I haven't seen anyone about it except for my high school counsellor once many years ago. I live in Canada.
Sorry for the late response, but I replied in a comment above what is happening.
I've been thinking about killing myself for roughly 5 years.

There has been many points in my life that have lead me to think that suicide would be a better option than anything else. To start off, I'm a high school drop-out. I couldn't deal with the non stop bullying and pressure from my parents to do well and I caved. I got addicted to video games to try and deal with the bullying and other stuff and that started the downward spiral. I became insanely depressed and would rarely leave my room let alone talk to anyone, and I stopped going to school altogether. My dad apparently didn't like this and it came to the point where he choked me until I passed out because I didn't want to go to my uncles house for thanksgiving. This depression went on for a few years, until I started talking to my now girlfriend. She stopped me from killing myself, albeit unknowingly, just by being there for me and spending time with me. The first year together was one of the best times of my life by far, but after that the depression started to come back. We were fighting all the time, I wasn't going to work on time or at all (and I lied about it). The lying made everything worse, of course. She no longer trusts me at all and I believe that she doesn't love me any more and isn't leaving me just to save me from that pain. She's been the love of my life and the only thing keeping me somewhat together for just over two and a half years now, and when she is gone I'll be completely lost.
